summary: Scilex Holding Company filed a Form 8-K reporting an amendment to a related-party promissory note, expanding an uncommitted revolving line of credit issued to Vivasor, Inc. The maximum aggregate principal amount was raised from $20,000,000 to $30,000,000 on September 25, 2026, with no other terms changed. Scilex CEO Dr. Henry Ji also serves as Vivasor's CEO, making this a related-party transaction approved by the Board and Audit Committee. This is a routine credit-facility amendment, not a special situation. Watch governance scrutiny and disclosure of affiliate lending, but no deal or arbitrage angle exists.
